purpose: Freeze Pair 6 lived relationship phenotype before using the supplied birth-derived chart for AstroRRF scoring.

relationship_context.relationship_transition: partner_fell_in_love_with_another_man_during_or_after_the_romantic_relationship; that relationship ended after external family pressure

altered_state_or_behavioral_episode.observed_behavior: During one major episode the partner struck the reference actor after he refused a requested soft drink; the user attributes the episode to jinn control/possession.
altered_state_or_behavioral_episode.epistemic_rule: Preserve the physical behavior and the user's attribution separately. Do not treat supernatural causation as established fact and do not convert it into a psychiatric diagnosis.
altered_state_or_behavioral_episode.similarity_note: User reports another development partner had comparably strong experiences interpreted as spirit/demon possession or magical-item sensitivity. This similarity is development context only.

currently_missing_or_useful_for_refineme: User-side and partner-side sexual satisfaction quality, not only attraction.
Partner baseline libido and desire stability over the relationship.
Whether partner wanted marriage/long-term commitment during the romantic period.
Whether either person was sexually or romantically jealous and how strongly.
Communication quality and repair during ordinary disagreements.
Whether high playful drama was enjoyed by both or became tiring to either person.
Practical-life fit beyond continued cohabitation: money, work, domestic labor, community-living preferences, children/family goals.
How quickly partner's attraction/love changed before falling in love with another man.
Whether partner's non-Eros love toward reference actor was more Storge, Agape/care, familial attachment, or another form.
chart_blind_rule: This phenotype is frozen before AstroRRF scoring of Pair 6. Birth time is provisional; sensitivity analysis is mandatory before using houses/angles as robust evidence.
